# United Kingdom

[global-law](../) / United Kingdom

1 repository under this folder (1 legislation, whole country). Each row links to the repository's current `main`; the folder of the same path is the submodule global-law pins and reads. "Coverage" is what the corpus says of itself; freshness is global-law's monitor.

## Completeness, checked against the official sources (2026-11-12)

| Constitution | Main codes | National law | Law-making regions | Case law |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| not held | 88% | 98% (estimate, medium confidence, 91.1–100.0%) | 100% | 0% |

united-kingdom-law holds the current revised text of 4,375 Acts not wholly repealed (3,418 UK Public General Acts plus 957 Acts of the Scottish Parliament, Senedd/National Assembly for Wales and Northern Ireland legislatures), current to 2026-10-31. Only 442 Acts (2010 onwards) have version history and the rest are current text only. It holds no statutory instruments (so no Civil Procedure Rules), no pre-1707 statutes (so no Magna Carta 1297 or Bill of Rights 1689) and no case law. The one spot check matches legislation.gov.uk, but the extent field is blank and the README and manifest still describe the earlier nine-provision EHCP record.

Shares are of what exists, not of what each repository says it holds; estimates are marked, with their method in [data/completeness.json](../data/completeness.json).
